diagnosis: The bird exists and lands the replacement; the white-robed stair figure carries the guest.
Penelope's stair line is the strongest run in Book 1: robed figures on bright steps.
Harper and reveller silence are missing; the hall at night is a black audience, not a household.

prologue: A king named Odysseus left his island of Ithaca to fight a ten-year war at Troy, and ten more years have passed without his return. At home his wife and son wait while a crowd of local men eat his food and press his wife to marry one of them and take his throne. Now the gods decide to bring him home.
